KEY FRUSTRATION Re-typing the same data into every canton’s PDF. KNOWS Model, output, floor area, the quote DOESN’T KNOW Ownership details, the owner’s login “I fill these in at night, in the van.” I2 Careful Caseworker Energy Office GOAL Decide on complete, legally sound files. KEY FRUSTRATION Chasing missing documents by phone. KNOWS The ordinance, the case system DOESN’T KNOW Whether a file is complete before opening it “Half my day is calling people back.” C1 TEST PROJECT · FICTIONAL EXAMPLE · FIG. 4
